M8 — 2026-10-08
`sofar upgrade` with no version installs the npm `latest` tag, so on an rc it silently DOWNGRADES (0.35.0-rc.3 → 0.34.1 on 2026-10-08). To move a machine to a release candidate, name it: `sofar upgrade 0.36.0-rc.1`. This machine has two global installs (fnm's, first on PATH, and ~/.local/bin); upgrade both, the second via `~/.local/bin/sofar upgrade <ver>`.
